verdict.rationale: Multiple docs confirm per-card spend limits, custom controls, embedded expense policies, and employee permissions/roles management (jeeves-docs-20, -23, -34, -22, -37), and this is corroborated by the MCP tool set that can adjust card spend limits programmatically (jeeves-docs-34). missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of granularity (e.g., per-category or per-merchant limits) and no third-party review confirming these controls work as documented in production.
